name: Baobab ERP Workload
description: Workload identity for the ERP engine. Gate IAM-10 (ADR-0014 §111): carries erp:integrate alongside context:resolve so iDempiere's own OSGi bundles can authenticate to baobab-app's integration boundary, not only baobab-cp. Also carries erp:read and erp:provision for the Boundary API (Shared#206); the client is tenant-neutral and carries no tenant_id, because tenant entitlement is a Control Plane decision (ADR-0007 sections 88-91).
